genre_archetype: electromagnetic lunar salvage with oxygen, battery, cart positioning, and base repair objectives
camera_perspective: fixed 2D side cutaway lunar salvage field with top cart rail and layered debris below
control_model: tap to fire hook, left and right buttons to reposition cart, scan button to reveal target roles, magnet boost button for one stronger pull
core_loop_signature: scan lunar wreckage, reposition cart, launch electromagnetic hook, recover parts batteries oxygen and repair cores, avoid meteor debris, repair base modules, unlock six ruin regions
differentiation_axes: oxygen and battery are active survival resources during each stage
cart position changes the launch geometry before each pull
magnetic material filtering makes metal, stone, oxygen, and battery targets behave differently
base repair modules convert recovered parts into region unlocks and permanent utility
meteor debris and fragile parts create risk beyond simple value collection
lunar sci-fi dashboard identity differs from crystal cave, farm, ranch, card, runner, and defense projects
forbidden_template_reuse: do not copy a classic hook miner loop as aim hook pull coins only
do not reuse crystal prism bending as the primary hook mechanic
do not use farm, ranch, care station, card table, runner lane, brawler street, or tower defense layouts
do not use a generic top score pill and bottom command strip that covers the hook field
do not represent salvage objects as plain circles without material, weight, survival, or repair roles

map_content_budget.play_area_model: side-view lunar surface with movable top rail, hook arc, layered salvage field, meteor lanes, and reserved HUD edges
map_content_budget.route_or_region_count: 6 lunar ruin regions with escalating salvage rules and base module objectives
map_content_budget.interactive_regions: cart rail, hook launch arc, shallow scrap layer, deep salvage layer, oxygen cache pockets, battery pockets, meteor hazard lanes, buried module part pockets, scanner overlay zone, and base repair objective rail
map_content_budget.decorative_prop_count: at least 18 prop families across antennas, panel shards, cable coils, boot tracks, warning beacons, cargo tags, crater stones, and module wreckage
map_content_budget.camera_or_scroll_model: fixed stage camera with optional subtle parallax background and no scrolling during a pull

secondary_player_actions: use battery cells to extend scanner and hook activity
recover fragile parts with slower safer pulls
special_rules: metal targets can magnet-lock while moon rocks bounce the hook
oxygen drains by time and battery drains by scanner or hook activity
meteor impacts damage cart hull or knock loose salvage
some critical parts must be recovered without hard impacts
risk_reward_systems: deep high-value parts cost more oxygen and battery
scanner use improves planning but consumes power
magnet boost can save a heavy pull but leaves less energy for later
oxygen pickups may be worth more than credits in late-stage pressure
failure_pressure_variants: timer-like repair window in late regions

primary_game_art_packs: lunar salvage cart and hook set
moon wreckage and spacecraft scrap set
life-support pickups and module repair set
asset_variety_budget.ui_pack: skin_military_tech with lunar dashboard gauges, segmented oxygen and battery meters, and blueprint repair panels
asset_variety_budget.animation_tier: medium 2D utility animation with rotating hook, cable extension, magnet pulse, cart tread movement, meteor drift, and dust impacts
asset_variety_budget.minimum_distinct_sprite_families: minimum 14 sprite families across cart, hook, oxygen, battery, six salvage object families, three hazard families, module schematics, scanner effects, and repair effects
asset_variety_budget.asset_reuse_note: Existing hook or mining assets may only be reused if the lunar cart, oxygen, battery, magnetic metal filtering, meteor hazards, and base repair identity are visually distinct from classic gold or crystal hook mining.
